diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period between completed bodies. The candidate implemented a one-shot sequence (period 0) and added a trailing delay, causing the first action to be missing at t=190000ms because the script had already terminated. The IR requires the body to repeat indefinitely.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period from 0 to 180000 to enable repetition. Removed the trailing delay(3 MIN) and restructured the script to execute the body actions, then delay, then loop back to the start of the body, matching the IR's cycle semantics.
